name: rfdetr_truck_medium_ema
architecture: RF-DETR Medium (DINOv2-windowed-small encoder), 1 class, input resolution 640 (square resize, multiple of 64)
input: RGB image, any size (resized internally); training frames were 1280x720

training.data: 4,811 frames rendered in NVIDIA Isaac Sim (Replicator) - 50 gaussian-splat trucks orbited by a camera; split BY TRUCK: 40 train / 5 val / 5 test trucks
training.augmentation: flip, blur, motion blur, gaussian/ISO noise, JPEG compression, brightness/contrast, gamma, CLAHE

metrics_held_out_trucks.note: held-out group-test split (trucks never seen in training); synthetic renders only

known_limitations: Trained ONLY on synthetic Isaac Sim renders of one truck family from a drone-like viewpoint. Accuracy on real photos/other vehicle types is NOT measured.

Phase-0 study on this model family measured ~0.8-0.86 false positives per truck-free (negative) image across degradation conditions - the AP numbers above do not show this because every test image contains a truck. Raise conf and/or add a min-box-area filter and verify on your own negative images before production use.
